convertibility_reason: Uses only price action comparison of two bars with built-in MT5 order functions. No custom indicators, no external .mqh dependencies, simple entry/exit logic with fixed SL/TP.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic compares two consecutive completed bars (bar[1] vs bar[2]). A buy signal is generated when bar[1] is bullish AND its body is larger than bar[2]'s body. A sell signal is generated when bar[1] is bearish AND its body is larger than bar[2]'s body. The comparison is based on the absolute body size (|Open-Close|) of each bar. Some variants also compare wick sizes or check for engulfing patterns. SL/TP values likely need digit adjustment (multiply by 10) for 5-digit brokers as the EA uses _Point for normalization.
python_conversion_notes: No indicators to port - pure price action comparison. Convert bar comparison logic to pandas DataFrame operations comparing consecutive candle bodies. Use shift(1) and shift(2) for bar[1] and bar[2] equivalents. SL/TP are fixed pip values - apply digit adjustment for JPY pairs and 5-digit brokers. New bar detection maps to resampling on bar boundaries. Simple structure suitable for direct translation.
